profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the Computer Software industry. Skilled in Computer Administration, Android Development, Software Development and Documentation, HTML/CSS, and Linux. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor’s Degree focused in Computer Science from Wentworth Institute of Technology.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: C++ · Software Infrastructure · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Delivered and deployed multiple releases of tactical SPY-6 (U.S. Navy Air and Missile Defense) radar software at ARDEL (Advanced Radar Detection Laboratory) site located at the Pacific Missile Range Facility in Kauai, HI
• Investigated SW/HW issues and implemented fixes with live radar array which contributed towards multiple successful track exercises/missions and acknowledgment by Navy counterparts
• Successfully investigated and resolved software integration issues with BL10 Combat System and provided BL10 integration team from Dahlgren/Lockheed Martin with software and network traffic analysis
• Designed, implemented and reworked DSP (digital signal processing) feature code, including EP (electronic protection) functionality, for multiple product baselines – RSPL, LTAMDS, SPY6
• Provided on-site/remote troubleshooting, analysis, and maintenance of 10Gb and Infiniband networks and resolved RDMA and DDS communication issues which affected mission critical network traffic at multiple sites
• Recognized as DSP SME and interim SW team lead of 3-5 individual contributors, consistently meeting deadlines
• Contained and remediated multiple data-spills of classified material while coordinating with remote security personnel and asset management

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Identified as key player in multiple releases for integration deliverables of mission planning software managing multiple assets and sensor types
• Hands on software and hardware integration for multiple systems and equipment, including spectrum analyzers, RF signal generators, and jamming subsystems
• Performed real-time embedded software development in C
• Evaluated complex Electronic Attack software designs to identify design flaws
• Researched, designed, and implemented new applications using an existing C++/Qt architecture
• Developed new and updated existing test programs to verify hardware requirements
• Researched and upgraded GCC compiler and Boost library versions to gain additional functionality

positions.title: Customer Support Engineer
positions.description:
•	Resolve software technical issues for end users using TestComplete 
•	Hold online meetings with customers for live investigation of issues
•	Reproduce user issues in lab environment
•	Keep customers updated on issue status using Salesforce
•	Serve as primary point of contact for customers during the issue lifecycle
•	Identify opportunities for operational improvement and assist in the development and roll-out of improved processes, methods and tools
•	Analyze log files and other supplemental data

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
•	Utilize knowledge of Java and C++ to implement software enhancements and revise 
existing code to improve run-time efficiency and readibility
•	Initial implementation of proof of concept design for HL7 message integration
•	Work with HTML, CSS, and JQuery to update and create user interfaces
•	Utilize Perforce and Git to download, sync, and update project files
•	Provide daily updates to team during stand-up and track task progress using Jira
•	Develop and test code changes on supported browsers and platforms

positions.title: Service Desk Intern
positions.description:
• Provide complete desktop, laptop, and mobile support in a 350+ user environment across three geographic locations
• Traveled to London, UK office to assist users and aid in office maintenance
• Database management
• Administrated Avaya IP office

positions.title: Junior Student Technical Support Specialist
positions.description:
•	Identify and troubleshoot software and system issues
•	Provide technical support for students, faculty members, and staff
•	Provide technical solutions one-on-one or over cellular devices
•	Provide device support; devices include desktops, laptops, Lync phones, iPhones, Androids, and tablets
•	Creating and managing all incidents in the ticket management system 
•	Escalate issues as needed and follow up to ensure a resolution
•	Manage student accounts and profiles through Active Directory 
•	Update documentation for troubleshooting issues on the knowledgebase

positions.title: Mobile, Personal Computer Home Office, Portable Electronics Sales Associate
positions.description:
•	Inspire customers by showing them what’s possible with technology
•	Support customers by giving technical advice and opinions
•	Engage customers using selling skills to build complex, connected solutions in a fast-paced, dynamic environment where customers feel supported and leave delighted.
•	Responsible for building profitable customer relationships to solve customers’ end to end needs using full range of products, services, solutions, and channels.
•	Use innovative training tools to stay current on information and technology
•	Maintain product displays for organization and replenishment
